items.name: cms-lib
items.title: agent-cms client and helpers
items.description: CmsProvider and useCms (REST client, UI strings in English and Korean), small hooks, shared parts (state badge, copy box, confirm dialog, page header, markdown preview).

items.name: cms-shell
items.title: Admin layout
items.description: Sidebar with collections, API keys and audit log, plus extraNav for your app's own screens. A sheet menu under 768px.

items.name: cms-empty
items.title: Empty collection
items.description: New document, and how to write with an agent instead (CLI one-liner, MCP URL, API key link).

items.name: cms-doc-list
items.title: Document list
items.description: State tabs with counts, category and author filters, search, 7-day views, selection with bulk publish, unpublish, hide, unhide and delete. Cards with long-press selection on phones.

items.name: cms-merge
items.title: Merge after a conflict
items.description: Three-way merge when someone saved first: what merged automatically, and theirs, mine or both for each conflict.

items.name: cms-doc-editor
items.title: Document editor
items.description: Info form generated from the collection schema, markdown with live preview, autosave and restore, problems on the fields, agent change review (accept, revert), save, publish, preview links.

items.name: cms-versions
items.title: Version history
items.description: Versions with author, note and changed fields; compare any two side by side or unified with word highlights; restore or publish a version.

items.name: cms-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: Keys with scopes, collections, last use and expiry; revoke; create with the secret shown once and MCP and CLI setup to copy.

items.name: cms-audit
items.title: Audit log
items.description: Who did what through which channel, filtered by action, who and result.

items.name: cms-command
items.title: Command menu
items.description: Cmd+K or Ctrl+K: find documents (drafts included) across collections and open, publish or start a new one.
